games.name: Money Rolling
games.instructions: Spin the 3 classic reels + multiplier reel. Unlock x2 (Bet 1) and x5 (Bet 5) bars, and trigger the top chained Prize Wheel (500 / 2,500 / 10,000)!
games.rewardRuleText: 3-reel slot + Half-Circle Bonus Wheel up to 10,000 · Auto & Turbo spin.

games.name: Hot Volcano Bonus Buy
games.instructions: Match 3 fiery fruits across the 3×3 volcano cabinet paylines. Land 3 FREE SPINS scatters or tap BONUS BUY for 10 Free Spins with x7 multiplier!
games.rewardRuleText: 3×3 Fiery Fruit Slot · Wild x500 · Bonus Buy 10 Free Spins with x7.

games.name: Aviator Pro
games.instructions: Place 1 or 2 independent bets before takeoff. Watch the red plane climb and tap Cashout before it flies away to lock Bet × Multiplier!
games.rewardRuleText: Dual Bet & Auto-Cashout Panels · Live Multiplier Curve from 1.00x.

games.name: Mines
games.instructions: Choose 1–24 mines, hit Start, and tap tiles on the 5×5 grid to uncover gold star coins. Cashout anytime before hitting a bomb!
games.rewardRuleText: 5×5 Grid Strategy · Escalating Multipliers (1.26x, 1.45x, 1.68x+) · Instant Cashout.

games.name: Twist / Symbol Wheel
games.instructions: Spin to light up segments across the 3 concentric rings (1.55x up to 200x & BONUS). Tap PART CASHOUT or CASHOUT before landing on a reset!
games.rewardRuleText: 3 Concentric Rings (Elemental & Symbol Themes) · Hold to Autoplay · Part Cashout.

games.name: Lucky Spin Wheel
games.instructions: Select your entry fee (₹10 to ₹500), choose your lucky color segment (Sapphire or Gold), and spin the wheel.
games.rewardRuleText: Entry fee ₹10 wins ₹30 (3.0×). Higher entry fees scale winnings proportionally. Server win ratio: 50%–60% random.

games.name: Dice Roll Duel
games.instructions: Pick your entry fee and predict whether the two rolled dice will land Low (2–6) or High (7–12).
games.rewardRuleText: Entry fee ₹10 wins ₹22 (2.2×). Win prize grows linearly with entry fee. Server win ratio: 50%–60% random.

games.name: Coin Flip Royale
games.instructions: Choose Heads or Tails, lock your entry fee, and flip the golden casino coin for an instant result.
games.rewardRuleText: Entry fee ₹10 wins ₹19 (1.9×). Higher entry tiers unlock higher instant payouts. Server win ratio: 50%–60% random.

games.name: Lucky 7 Cards
games.instructions: Select your entry fee and call whether the drawn royal card is Low (2–7) or High (8–Ace).
games.rewardRuleText: Entry fee ₹10 wins ₹25 (2.5×). Payout scales directly with entry amount. Server win ratio: 50%–60% random.

games.name: Treasure Mines
games.instructions: Set your entry fee and tap a mystery chest on the 3×3 vault grid to uncover gems and avoid hidden mines.
games.rewardRuleText: Entry fee ₹10 wins ₹28 (2.8×). Higher entry stakes yield proportionally larger rewards. Server win ratio: 50%–60% random.

games.name: Slot Jackpot 777
games.instructions: Choose your entry fee and pull the lever to spin all 3 sapphire-and-gold reels for a winning match.
games.rewardRuleText: Entry fee ₹10 wins ₹30 (3.0×). Entry ₹100 wins ₹300. Server win ratio: 50%–60% random.
